nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: The Amethyst Core pulses with ancient energy. You have ventured deep into Room 2.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Answer this riddle: which inner compass guides your path through the rooms?

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: A calculated mind builds sturdy bridges across the unknown.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Passion burns bright, though it can blind you to lurking shadows.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Fortune favors the bold, but tests the unprepared.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Curiosity is the flame that brought you here. Never allow it to be extinguished.
